L99: 
L100: The 2027-2028 Davidson Academy Online application is now available!
L101: 
L102: 【9†How to Apply】
L103: # Tuition and Aid
L104: 
L105: for the 2026-27 School Year
L106: 
L107: Davidson Academy Online uses a flexible tuition model that takes into consideration annual family income, cost of living adjustment based on location of primary residence, the number of dependents in the household, and other relevant factors to determine a personalized tuition level for each family.
L108: The flexible tuition model is calculated by completing an application through FAST (Financial Aid for School Tuition), a third-party online service that offers a standardized, confidential process to ensure an equitable platform for all applicants. Families who wish to know their tuition amount first, before completing a Davidson Academy Online application, may complete the FAST process. There is a $60 non-refundable application fee payable upon submission of the application.
L109: FAST applications for the 2026-27 school year are currently closed.
L110: Additionally, students who are on a personalized tuition plan may have access to loaner textbooks.
L111: ## Tuition for the 2026-27 School Year
L112: 
L113: ### Nevada Residents
L114: 
L115: Tuition for Davidson Academy Online full-time enrollment is waived with proof of Nevada residency in the form of a Nevada Real ID.
L116: 
L117: ### High School - Non-Nevada Residents
L118: 
L119: Students over the age of 14 on September 30, 2026 are considered high school students.
L120: 
L121: Tuition is $17,000.
L122: 
L123: ### Middle School - Non-Nevada Residents
L124: 
L125: Students under the age of 14 on September 30, 2026 are considered middle school students.
L126: 
L127: Tuition is $13,000.
L128: ### Single-Course Enrollment Students
L129: 
L130: Tuition is $5,000 per course regardless of state of residence.
L131: 
L132: Courses that earn more than 0.5 credit per semester are not available to single course students.
L133: 
L134:   * Financial assistance may be available through the Davidson Institute for Davidson Young Scholars.
L135: ## Other Fees
L136: 
L137: These fees apply to all students, regardless of state of residence.
L138: 
L139:   * The cost of all required textbooks and science lab kits.
L140:   * Students will need a computer with a web camera and microphone. We require a desktop or laptop with a robust Internet connection for most coursework, as our live sessions use audio and video streaming.

L170: The mission of Davidson Academy Online is to provide profoundly gifted young people an advanced educational opportunity matched to their abilities, strengths, and interests.
L171: 
L172: Profoundly gifted students are those who score in the 99.9th percentile on IQ and achievement tests.
L173: Davidson Academy Online is an independent school operated by the Davidson Institute.

L139: # boarding at UWC-usa
L140: 
L141: We aim to foster a healthy living and learning community, practicing habits that sustain us and others and the environment we share. We practice an ethics of care.
L142: 
L143: 【11†Visits】
L144: 
L145: 【31†LIVING】
L146: 
L147: ## Residential Life
L148: 
L149: UWC-USA is not a big community, so there’s always someone watching out; there’s always someone helping out. With many faculty and staff living on campus, students have many trusted adults—and peers—to turn to for support.
L150: #### Faculty Support
L151: 
L152: Residential Coordinators (RCs), trained in first aid and mental health assessment and response, and an Assistant RC live in each
L153: residence hall. Schedules are staggered to ensure 24-hour on-call availability.
L154: #### Peer Network
L155: 
L156: Students forge relationships with a diverse group of peers, sometimes with very different values. Peer Residential Advisors (RAs) provide leadership in the dorms around wellness, conflict transformation, sustainability, and IDEA (inclusion, diversity, equity and accessibility).
L157: #### Advisors
L158: 
L159: Students at UWC USA are assigned an faculty advisor and are part of a cohort of 7-8 advisees. The advisor is a regular source of support for students’ academic, social, experiential and residential experiences.
L160: ### Living Together
L161: 
L162: At the heart of the UWC ethos is respect for self and others in all circumstances–in both actions and words. We ask our students to think about the common good and to rise above their individual desires and needs. Discipline at UWC-USA emphasizes restorative over punitive practices. Only in specific cases is a purely disciplinary response taken.
L163: ###### Living by Our Nine Core Values
L164: 
L165: Our values define our community. Not just words on a page, they guide our decisions and are exemplified by our daily actions.
L166: 
L167: ###### Community Agreements
L168: 
L169: All students are expected to abide by a set of Community Agreements while on campus and during school-related activities. Community agreements align with the 【57†UWC Movement Code of Conduct†uwc.org】.
L170: ###### Residential Responsibilities
L171: 
L172: Students are responsible for using shared spaces considerately, performing scheduled dorm duties, and taking care of campus property.
L173: 
L174: 【58†Image: Diverse students walk down the stairs to class at UWC-USA.】
L175: ## Exploring Off Campus
L176: 
L177: When students want to get off campus they have opportunities to explore the beauty and culture of New Mexico, or spend a weekend with a local Get-Away family. All students participate in learing expeditions at various places in the region.
L178: 【25†Learning Expeditions Offering place-based exploration and a sense of perspective, learning expeditions take place off campus, immersing students in real-world experiences that inspire curiosity and action.】 【11†Discover Historic New Mexico New Mexico offers more than scenic beauty.
L179: The area has a rich history, with a culture infused with Spanish, Mexican and Native American influences.】 【43†Learn About Get-Away Families Local families offer students an opportunity to get off campus for short stays to experience life in a typical US home.】
